set.body:
Epic: bd-01KXYJK0XSA3RNH9ANMVC96EPE

Audit and migrate generic numerical duplicates outside scalafim.linalg.

Scope includes scalafim.image.DMat and its Gauss-Jordan inverse, HRF-local Mat and Vec, motion solve6, RSA linear-system helpers, and other private inverse, QR, SVD, or eigen families. Replace image matrices with typed affine or transform wrappers over Gale where appropriate. Move ordinary HRF matrix and vector work to Gale but retain domain-specific Complex and FFT support unless Gale adds a suitable cross-platform complex tier. A tiny specialized solver may remain only with a domain justification and benchmark evidence.

Acceptance
Repository scans find no unjustified generic matrix or solver families outside Gale. Image and HRF public semantics, serialization, equality, and JVM and JS tests remain intact. Every retained specialization is documented with its invariant or performance rationale.
set.title: Scalafim Gale migration 5: remove related matrix and solver duplicates
